description: This file contains functions and notes related to upgrading Buffalo devices with MT7622 chips, including checks for TRX + UBI formatted images, handling of sysupgrade tar archives, and U-Boot behavior management. It is used during firmware upgrade processes for specific device models.

methods.name: buffalo_check_image
methods.description: Checks the validity and compatibility of a firmware image for Buffalo devices, including TRX+UBI formatted images and sysupgrade tar files.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_ubinized
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process for TRX+UBI formatted images on Buffalo devices, handling UBI detachment, partition erasure, and image writing.
